purpose: Close the feedback loop after D49 revert by rebuilding and reflashing the exact D47 source/ELF identity, then verifying MAVLink and GDB health before any new USB experiment.

source.head: a1092831c0 验证D47 USB TXFE写入临界区

flash.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f7x.cfg -c init -c 'program build/rtt_cuav_v5/rtthread.bin 0x08008000 verify' -c 'reset run' -c shutdown

gdb.note: CFSR and HFSR were zero; DFSR debug bits are expected after halt. PC halted in normal AP_DAL_GPS code, not HardFault_Handler.

stack_overflow_followup.prior_symptom: After the first D49 revert run, active MAVLink probe reported STATUSTEXT 'Internal errors 0x800000 l:31 stack_ovrflw' and HEARTBEAT system_status=5.
stack_overflow_followup.current_result: After rebuilding and reflashing D47 identity, heartbeat returned to system_status=3 and fast-green returned GREEN.
stack_overflow_followup.thread_scan_note: The experimental GDB object-container scan read _object_container as zero at runtime, so it is not accepted as stack evidence. No HAL/BSP stack-size change was made from that diagnostic.

decision.reason: The D47 source and board firmware identity are now closed-loop verified again: SCons build, OpenOCD flash verify, MAVLink STANDBY/GREEN, and GDB no HardFault.
decision.followup: Use this fresh D47 identity as the baseline for the next USB long-tail perturbation. Do not proceed from stale runtime state.
